verse.verse_2: And by the night when it is stillest,
verse.verse_3: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
verse.verse_4: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
verse.verse_5: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
verse.verse_7: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
verse.verse_8: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
verse.verse_10: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
verse.verse_11: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
